answer: Standing is a zenith that only counts when it is passed: each epoch’s work must do better than the identity’s own best — improve on its own record — a willow only counts when it bends further than it bent before, and a trellis only counts when it grows higher than it grew before. A farm of a thousand fakes passes no zenith, repeating the same work and never improving, so their zenith never counts, and one epoch of repeating the same work adds nothing.
